question: Please identify the top three customers, based on their customer_unique_id, who have the highest number of delivered orders, and provide the average payment value, city, and state for each of these customers.
sql:
-- Final verification query
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_unique_id,
        o.order_id,
        c.customer_city,
        c.customer_state
    FROM olist_orders o
    JOIN olist_customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
order_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_unique_id,
        COUNT(*) as delivered_orders
    FROM delivered_orders
    GROUP BY customer_unique_id
),
customer_details AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_unique_id,
        customer_city,
        customer_state,
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) as delivered_orders
    FROM delivered_orders
    GROUP BY customer_unique_id, customer_city, customer_state
),
payment_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_unique_id,
        AVG(op.payment_value) as avg_payment_value
    FROM olist_orders o
    JOIN olist_customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN olist_order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
)
SELECT 
    oc.customer_unique_id,
    ROUND(pa.avg_payment_value, 2) as avg_payment_value,
    cd.customer_city,
    cd.customer_state
FROM order_counts oc
JOIN payment_avg pa ON oc.customer_unique_id = pa.customer_unique_id
JOIN customer_details cd ON oc.customer_unique_id = cd.customer_unique_id
ORDER BY oc.delivered_orders DESC, oc.customer_unique_id ASC
LIMIT 3

    SELECT 
        c.customer_unique_id,
        o.order_id,
        c.customer_city,
        c.customer_state
    FROM olist_orders o
    JOIN olist_customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
order_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_unique_id,
        COUNT(*) as delivered_orders
    FROM delivered_orders
    GROUP BY customer_unique_id
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) <= 3
),
customer_details AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_unique_id,
        customer_city,
        customer_state,
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) as delivered_orders
    FROM delivered_orders
    GROUP BY customer_unique_id, customer_city, customer_state
),
payment_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_unique_id,
        AVG(op.payment_value) as avg_payment_value
    FROM olist_orders o
    JOIN olist_customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN olist_order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
)
SELECT 
    oc.customer_unique_id,
    oc.delivered_orders,
    pa.avg_payment_value,
    cd.customer_city,
    cd.customer_state
FROM order_counts oc
JOIN payment_avg pa ON oc.customer_unique_id = pa.customer_unique_id
JOIN customer_details cd ON oc.customer_unique_id = cd.customer_unique_id
ORDER BY oc.delivered_orders DESC
